t: Egyptian Constants Engineering: Self-Generation System — Simple
name: Egyptian Constants Engineering: Self-Generation System — Simple

description:

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Seed-space diversity for 128-bit seeds = 128.0 bits. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.

requirements: Re-run the demo program to re-verify every number
standards: Full-file record, never a stub
